title: Cook Ding Carves an Ox

source.book: Zhuangzi, Nourishing the Lord of Life
source.quote: Between the joints there are spaces, and the blade has no thickness. With no thickness it enters where there is space, and wide and easy there is room for the blade to glide. That is why after nineteen years the edge is as if fresh from the whetstone.

moral: Find the seam in the thing, follow it, and you need not force anything.
